display_title: Are we just seeing each other for your looks?

titles.title: Are we just seeing each other for your looks?

description:
Seong Lee-Gyeom, 27, has nothing in life but his face. Following the saying that a face is worth everything, he started his rental boyfriend business as soon as he became an adult, and even after seven years, he's maintained his unwavering ★ace★ status. 

Now I'm going to bite a really big guy and leave this place! In front of Lee-Gyeom, who shouts, " I'm going to bite a really big guy and leave this place!" appears Jin Gyu-Tae with frizzy hair, high-precision glasses, a checked shirt that he found somewhere, and a nerd-looking guy who looks like he's reeking of a loner even when seen from a moving train... Just as he was about to eat it all off with a chili pepper to kill time, he takes off those damn glasses and those crappy clothes and it looks a lot better... Honestly, shouldn't a loner grow up like that? He's not going to be able to wear it anyway...

(Source: MrBlue, translated)
